en: All right. I don't know if I can stop Savio, but...
I'll try.
Thank you... Rudi. I'm sorry. I deceived you...
No, that doesn't matter anymore... I've learned how naive I was...
It stings, though...
About your brother... I'm still... I'm so sorry.
My brother didn't die because of you. I know now it was the House of Nobles who did it...
What I have to do now isn't grieve for my brother.
Doing that wouldn't make him happy...
I saw the demons in the imperial army... Devils summoned by their mages.
I have to do everything I can to protect this country from them.
I can't stand still... The danger is right on our doorstep.
My brother always said he'd stay true to his own path as king...
I'll carry on that will... He's still alive inside me.
So I have to end this country's pointless fighting.
Rudi... We know where Savio will fight next...
I can't let my brother run wild any longer...
Where is it? Tell me.
A town called Faro, in Ellora...
If he goes after the nobles in a rage again... the armor will really swallow him...
All right, don't worry. I'll stop Savio...
Thank you... Rudi... Even though I deceived you...
No, that doesn't matter now. There's something I have to do.
Rudi...
I spoke with your brother just once, at the palace...
Really? Did he say anything?
He said his little brother Rudi was his pride and joy. He looked so happy talking about you.
He didn't seem like a king at all...
And I thought, ah, so this is Rudi's brother...
Just an ordinary face... The face of a brother thinking of his little brother...
That's why I couldn't... lay a hand on your brother, Rudi... on the king...
So that's how it was...
Rudi... That pendant on your chest. Is it the same as your brother's?
Savia v
...I see.
I'm sorry. I suppose I've been fighting too long...
I never even noticed that...
It's fine... We're the ones who'll calm this chaos and make this a peaceful country...
Starting now.
Rudi...
Savia... You were... one of the assassins...
There's something I need to ask you...
Was it... was it you who killed my brother...?
...No, Rudi.
It's true I deceived you and meant to kill the king...
But I didn't do it... The nobles did...
They knew all about me, and they deceived you.
I thought I was the one deceiving you, but they were using me...
You may not believe a word I say, but...
Those nobles set a trap for you and your brother to seize the throne...
No...
It's true... That's how they work...
Western nobles, Eastern nobles... All they ever think about is how to line their own pockets.
Your brother was at odds with the nobles...
He said the country had to be united or disaster would follow, and the powerful nobles turned on him.
They pinned the blame on you and took the throne's power into their own hands.
Because they knew we were plotting in secret to kill the royal family...
That's insane... My brother was trying to unite the country because he took the Empire's threat seriously...
Western nobles, Eastern nobles, they're all the same... They'll do anything to save their own skins... Filthy wretches...
If they keep this up... they'll play right into the Empire's hands...
The Empire's demons are right on our doorstep... Damn it!!
That's why we're getting rid of those foolish nobles... They're a disease killing this country...
No, what you're doing is wrong... Stop fighting right now and prepare for the imperial army.
Rudi, you're naive... Someone has to take action...
As long as these nobles live, nothing you do will matter.
That's pointless! Killing each other in our own country... if we keep this up...
So you'd rather let them do as they please?
No... It's just...
In the end, you're royalty. I can't expect you to understand...
Goodbye, Rudi.
Wait, Savia!
Siblings
Savio Transforms
Stop it! Savio!
You... Don't get in my way...
I'll make every human alive understand my pain...
The pain of being burned alive. The pain that's still burning now...
I hate everything...
The nobles who tricked me... the world that bore me...
I have to stop you. Throw that armor away, Savio.
That pain is the armor's curse.
Sh-shut up, you... Die.
Wait, Savio!!
Please, let's stop... This fighting won't save anyone...
Out of my way... Savia.
Please, the armor... take off the armor... It's driving you mad...
...No... This armor is my life...
Please...
...Move...
Aaah!!
You!!
...Rudi, stop... Savio...
Savia!!!
...Savia... What's wrong...
Don't you get it...? You did this!
I-I... Savia... Savia...
What... The armor... My body won't obey me...
Help me... Savia...
Raaaaaaaaagh!
Damn it!!
Sibling Battle (Won)
Savia!!
...Where's Savio?
The armor... swallowed him... I had no choice...
...I see. Poor Savio... But it's over now, isn't it...
I'm sorry...
It's all right... now...
Rudi... thank you... I'm glad I got to meet you...
Goodbye...
I'll be taking back what you stole, Mr. Thief.
Don't make it sound so bad. Somebody handed this over to me.
Well, without telling them, but still.
Quit talking nonsense and give it back!
Whew, you're a hothead, pal. I can't stand guys with short fuses.
Fine. I was only doing a favor anyway...
I'll give it back.
But only to the angel.
You're there, right, Angel?
You're the one who really wants it, aren't you?
So you're the Empire's witch...
You're the one who brought chaos to this world!
And you're the one controlling Endymion too!
Hmph, what does a child know... You can't stop me.
Endymion!!
Ugh...
I've come to defeat you, you devil's pawn!
Big talk, angel's hero.
But I'm not dying before I see the end of the world!
Hey, sneak thief! Gonna tuck your tail and run again?
Hmph, I'm not running. I can handle the likes of you.
Endymion... No, you're a devil now...
I've come to defeat you...
Hmph... Such worthless sentiment...
That is what I hate most about you humans.
You devil... I'll never forgive you...
Toying with people like that...
To the Heavenly Dragon, humans and their guardian angel are mere nourishment...
Be silent and die.
No, you're wrong...
You devil... I will never forgive what you've done.
I'll defeat you, no matter what.
There's no truth in a devil's words!
Don't think words like that will scare me!
Damn...
Rudi!!
...What's this?
You... You did this to these people?
How could you do something so cruel!
That crest shining on your chest is the crest of the Kingdom of Legrance... Are you of Legrance's royal family?
Yes, I am. My name is Rudiere Trier.
I see. For someone in a position of such responsibility, you've done well to come all this way.
What's more, only the blessed may enter this place. You are with the angel, aren't you?
Yes... The angel is with me. But about being blessed...
I understand that it may be hard to grasp. Rudiere, would you come a little closer?
Ah! Y-yes...
When signs of chaos appear in the world, children of man are blessed and guided by the angels.
The angel has chosen you as one of those who will save this world, now that an evil shadow is spreading over it.
Many hardships surely await you from here on. But please, keep a strong will.
For the enemy preys on weak hearts that waver and doubt.
...I understand... Um... May I ask you something?
What is it?
Do you know the true identity of the one throwing this world into chaos?
I am only recalling events from long, long ago... things that have since become legend.
In time, you will face an even more terrible battle.
